pins.section: ## 6. Adapter lifecycle: init, cancellation, parentless collider, disposal

cases.title: focus loss clears held state, emits a neutral frame and requires fresh activation
cases.trigger: window blur during gameplay
cases.durableEffect: none; the next step receives moveX 0 / jump none and a later press is a real pressed edge

pins.section: ### 5.3 Suspension: focus loss, hidden tab, page hide

cases.title: active gamepad disconnect clears its contribution and never emits a phantom pressed
cases.trigger: gamepaddisconnected while the primary button is down
cases.durableEffect: none; a takeover pad must observe an up before any pressed

cases.title: hidden tab + resume: dropped wall time executes no phantom step and replays no edge
cases.trigger: visibilitychange hidden for 5 s, then visible
cases.durableEffect: none; stepIndex stays contiguous and every executed step is sampled exactly once

pins.section: ### 5.3 Suspension: focus loss, hidden tab, page hide
## 6. Step indexing, settle pre-roll and initialization

cases.title: a collider inside a parent group is a validation error, not flattened geometry
cases.trigger: snapshot with components.collider on a non-root entity
cases.durableEffect: none; the snapshot is rejected before any world or module instance exists

cases.title: a scaled collider is rejected instead of being silently scaled
cases.trigger: snapshot with transform.scale [2,1,1] on a collider entity
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: a rotated controller entity is rejected (the capsule is never tilted)
cases.trigger: snapshot with a non-identity quaternion on the controller entity
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: two modules claiming one entity transform are rejected at instantiate
cases.trigger: modules demo:box-motion + platformer:controller with overlapping owners
cases.durableEffect: none; no port is stepped and no module create() side effect is retained (modules are created only after validation)

cases.title: the M1 box-motion demo and the M2 controller cannot be selected together
cases.trigger: modules [demo:box-motion, platformer:controller]
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: a module throw after the physics phase fail-stops the simulation; private state is not rolled back
cases.trigger: transform-phase module throws after port.step() succeeded at stepIndex 480
cases.durableEffect: none; the last completed step's render state stays readable (alpha 0), start/tick reject with runtime_failed, only dispose+fresh instantiate recovers

cases.title: a cancelled physics initialization releases everything and a later init succeeds
cases.trigger: AbortSignal aborted during createPhysicsPort
cases.durableEffect: none; no PhysicsPort object escapes and a subsequent createPhysicsPort succeeds

pins.section: ## 6. Adapter lifecycle: init, cancellation, parentless collider, disposal

cases.title: a WASM/init failure reports an actionable unavailable state with no fallback
cases.trigger: createPhysicsPort rejects (WASM/CSP failure)
cases.durableEffect: none; play does not silently switch engines or fall back to transform-only motion

pins.section: ## 6. Adapter lifecycle: init, cancellation, parentless collider, disposal

cases.title: an 8-step catch-up frame consumes a pressed edge exactly once
cases.trigger: one frame executes 8 steps with a recorded pressed edge at the first of them
cases.assertion: runtime/catchup.json C6: pressedCount 1, one sample per executed index
cases.durableEffect: none; the same frame index is never sampled twice

pins.section: ### 3.2 Press latch — exactly one edge per executed step
### 2.1 Fixed-step ordering (normative, replacing nothing in M1's per-step math)

cases.title: dropped wall time produces no phantom physics or input steps
cases.trigger: 1.0 s stall
cases.assertion: runtime/catchup.json C3/C7: 8 steps executed, 112/52 dropped, contiguous indices
cases.durableEffect: none; stepIndex advances only for executed steps and the union of executed indices has no gaps

cases.title: a module claiming the camera entity is rejected
cases.trigger: transformOwners includes the camera entity
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: writing curr outside the transform phase fail-stops instead of mutating a half-applied step
cases.trigger: controller-phase module writes state.curr
cases.durableEffect: none; prev/curr remain the last completed step values

cases.title: a malformed CharacterMoveResult fail-stops before anything is committed
cases.trigger: port.step() returns grounded true with a zero support normal
cases.durableEffect: none; the invalid result is never applied

cases.title: two staged moves for one character in one step are rejected
cases.trigger: stageCharacterMove called twice for the same entity in one controller phase
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: an M2 module cannot run against a schemaVersion 1 snapshot
cases.trigger: modules [platformer:controller] with a v1 scene
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: an M2 controller module requires exactly one controller entity
cases.trigger: scene with zero or two components.controller entities
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: the controller module cannot be instantiated without an injected port
cases.trigger: modules [platformer:controller] with no physics config
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: a throwing action source fail-stops and is not retried
cases.trigger: actions.sample() throws
cases.durableEffect: none

stateMachine.recovery: dispose + fresh instantiateRuntime with fresh module instances and a fresh port
